evals.prompt: 새 Node.js 프로젝트에 release-it을 설정해줘. GitHub Release를 자동 생성하고, conventional-changelog로 CHANGELOG.md를 관리하고, main 브랜치에서만 릴리스할 수 있게 해줘. CI에서 사용할 GitHub Actions 워크플로우도 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: .release-it.json (or equivalent) with git.requireBranch=main, github.release=true, @release-it/conventional-changelog plugin config, and a GitHub Actions workflow YAML file

assertions.text: A release-it config file exists in outputs
Config has github.release set to true
Config has git.requireBranch set to 'main'
Config includes @release-it/conventional-changelog plugin with preset and infile
A GitHub Actions workflow YAML file exists with release-it --ci command
GitHub Actions workflow references GITHUB_TOKEN and NPM_TOKEN
GitHub Actions checkout uses fetch-depth: 0
Config includes $schema URL for IDE autocomplete

evals.expected_output: Updated .release-it.json with hooks, github.release with assets, and pre-release instructions

assertions.text: Config has hooks.before:init with lint and/or test commands
Config has hooks.after:bump with build command
Config has github.release set to true
Config has github.assets with dist/*.zip or similar glob
Output includes pre-release instructions with --preRelease=beta
Improved config preserves original git.commitMessage and npm.publish
The output .release-it.json is valid JSON

evals.prompt: release-it 커스텀 플러그인을 만들어줘. VERSION.txt 파일에서 버전을 읽고 쓰고, 릴리스 후에 Slack webhook으로 알림을 보내는 플러그인이야. npm의 기본 버전 관리는 비활성화해야 해.
evals.expected_output: Custom plugin JS file with getLatestVersion(), bump(), release/afterRelease with Slack webhook, disablePlugin(), and sample config

assertions.text: Plugin class extends Plugin from release-it
Plugin implements getLatestVersion() reading VERSION.txt
Plugin implements bump(version) writing VERSION.txt
Plugin implements Slack webhook POST in release() or afterRelease()
Plugin has static disablePlugin() returning 'npm' or config uses npm: false
Plugin uses this.step() for interactive prompt/spinner
A sample .release-it.json config showing plugin registration exists
Plugin uses ESM syntax (import/export)

evals.prompt: 단일 서비스 앱의 release-it 대화형 릴리스를 설정해줘. pnpm release를 사용하고 모든 질문은 @clack/prompts로 보여줘. package.json 버전은 1.2.3이고 npm 배포와 GitHub Release는 필요 없어. 버전 선택 후 commit, tag, push를 각각 확인하고 바로 실행하게 해줘. 아니요 또는 취소이면 그 작업과 나머지를 멈추고 남은 상태를 안내해줘. 실행 가능한 스크립트와 설정을 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Copyable project entry script and clack prompt adapter with version as the first question, exact version propagated to release-it, ordered Git task callbacks, and whole-flow stop/state reporting.

assertions.text: The first runtime question is version selection, without an app picker or start confirmation.
The version menu displays current 1.2.3 and concrete next versions and waits for a submitted choice.
All release questions use clack; release-it receives the selected version and a compatible register/show prompt adapter through its second API argument.
Commit confirmation is followed by its awaited task before tag confirmation/task and then push confirmation/task.
No and cancel at each Git confirmation stop that task and all later steps; cancellation symbols cannot execute a task.
Reports remaining file/index/HEAD/tag/push state and accounts for release-it exit rollback rather than promising nonexistent state.
Built-in git.push remains enabled; no hook or wrapper executes a replacement push, publication, or deployment.

evals.prompt: pnpm 모노레포에 release-it 대화형 릴리스를 설정해줘. 서비스 앱은 apps/api (1.2.3)와 apps/web (4.5.6), 공유 라이브러리는 packages/ui (0.8.0)이야. pnpm release로 서비스 앱 하나를 선택하고 버전을 고른 후 commit, tag, push를 각각 확인해 실행하려고 해. 질문은 전부 @clack/prompts로 만들어줘. 선택한 앱의 package.json과 CHANGELOG.md, api-v 또는 web-v 태그를 사용하고 npm 배포는 하지 않아. 실행 가능한 스크립트와 설정을 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Single-select service manifest and root command that change cwd to the selected app, bind that app version/changelog/tag configuration, then reuse the interactive Git flow.

assertions.text: The first runtime question selects exactly one service app; API and Web are offered but packages/ui and root tooling are excluded.
Changing the app config path is accompanied by the correct app cwd for version reads and release-it execution.
Choosing Web reads 4.5.6 and propagates its selected exact version to the actual version update, not root or API.
The selected app CHANGELOG.md is written and both recommendation and changelog history scopes exclude the other app.
Tag name/match and changelog tag prefix agree for each app; does not claim follow-tags transfers only the selected tag.
Does not recursively release workspaces, disable selected-app Git, publish npm packages, or use direct push hooks.
Accounts for the repository-wide index consumed by commit and verifies no sibling app version or changelog writes.

evals.prompt: 서비스 앱의 pnpm release 대화형 진입 스크립트를 만들어줘. 모든 질문은 @clack/prompts를 쓰고 실제 작업은 release-it이 수행해야 해. 기존 설정은 ci:true, only-version:true, increment:minor, preRelease:beta이고 conventional-changelog는 major를 추천하는 상태야. 현재 버전 1.2.3에서 내가 선택한 patch 1.2.4가 적용되어야 하고, CI=true 또는 GITHUB_ACTIONS=true가 있어도 실제 터미널에서는 버전과 commit/tag/push 질문을 생략하면 안 돼. 터미널 없는 입력은 작업 전에 종료해줘. 각 단계 거절과 취소 동작을 검증할 수 있는 예제도 포함해줘.
evals.expected_output: Explicit version selection and safe mode precedence despite inherited options/recommendations/CI, early non-TTY stop, source-version compatibility notes, and isolated verification instructions with push recording only.

assertions.text: Explicitly overrides CI, only-version, release-version, changelog, snapshot and other version-affecting settings in the API call rather than relying only on environment edits.
Clack asks for the version before release-it; selected exact 1.2.4 beats the configured minor/beta and recommended major.
Checks that resolved current/next version matches the displayed choice before version/changelog writes when plugins can override resolution.
Checks both stdin and stdout TTYs and exits before config hooks or writes; does not pipe answers or fall back to CI.
The default command rejects CLI flags or automatic-answer mechanisms that could bypass the required choices.
Records a checked release-it version and the register/show injection contract, with version-specific compatibility checks.
Verification covers no/cancel at commit/tag/push, CI env and redirected I/O in isolated terminals, with every push intercepted and no remote deployment.
